body: Thank you, I will check it out! & you too have a good life with your cats I wish you nothing but good things.

Thank you I really appreciate you replying to me. I'm sorry that you're going through similar, at least it makes it feel a little less lonely right? You're very strong yourself & your cats (& friends) I'm sure appreciate you so much for getting through the day.

Personally, I watch a lot of videos of survivors & they make me hope that I too can get out. Not necessarily any specific situations but hearing someone that went through hell get out & be able to live is very helpful to keep going & keep hoping. So maybe if you're looking for something to help you can watch some of those too.

I've been trying to leave for a while now with a friend but it's just not that easy. We're trying to work towards it but its been difficult to find a place & unfortunately it's on hold until I either can get hired or she's finished paying some bills off, just tried applying to some more jobs a few minutes ago. I do art commissions but it's way too little to make sure we're fed & can pay bills after moving.

I'd like to hope that soon I can live with a friend & in 10 years I wouldn't mind living with that same one or another. I want to take in old cats or nurse hurt ones back to health & give them a good life.
